modules.html: In a rather remote but quite special and scenically spectacular location

We invite you to share with us the delights of self catering accommodation on the North Nottinghamshire & South Yorkshire border, in the very heart of the Idle River Valley near to the village of Mattersey.

In an area rich with Outdoor Activities that will be fun for all the family.

All cottages have the following facilities;-
Electric cooker & hotplates, Dishwasher, Microwave, Fridge with icebox or Freezer, Smart Television, Patio Furniture Shared BBQ, Gas Central Heating. Laundry room with washing machines and drier, ironing facility, Childrens play area Large carpark, with some covered spaces.

modules.html:
Blaco Hill Farm Cottages are situated on a working farm just outside Mattersey, on the Nottinghamshire and South Yorkshire border.

On the farm itself are three lakes, which have a wide variety of bird life both native and visiting species.

Adjacent to the farm is the Nottinghamshire Wildlife Trusts Idle Valley nature reserve, which is a site of Special Scientific Interest and has a diverse variety of bird & wildlife.

In an area rich with Outdoor Activities that will be fun for all the family. And if the weather is not so good we have a Games Room equipped with a full size snooker table, table tennis and a large comfortable seating area. Please feel free to look around our site.

We do hope you find Blaco Hill a relaxing, care-free environment and hopefully we will have the pleasure of your company in the near future.

We are here for you – to help you plan, organize, and fulfill your dreams of a relaxing, self catering holiday away from all the stresses of everyday life, here in Mattersey.

modules.author: Kate Bull
modules.html: I have been here many times. This place is for those who like walking, birds and resting in the evenings, maybe using their library. So peaceful there.

modules.author: Alex Smith
modules.html: We stayed here after getting married at the secret garden in gringley. It was so tranquil and peaceful. Really beautiful surroundings just wish we had spent more time at the cottage. Can't fault the cottage as modern, clean and has everything you need.

modules.author: Rebecca P
modules.html: Fab little find. Lovely cottage with everything you need for a weekend get away. Games room an added bonus and cottage kitted out for all your needs. Clean with linen provided, plenty of room for 6 of us and didn’t feel cramped.

modules.author: Burl Brown
modules.html: We stayed here whilst visiting family in the area and couldn't have asked for more. They are beautifully converted cottages, with everything you could need amongst stunning countryside. Great routes for walks or runs in the countryside, perfect for building up an appetite. Will definitely be back!

modules.title: Nature & Wildlife
modules.html:
Idle Valley Nature Reserve located just a couple of miles south of Blaco Hill, this spectacular wetland site covers an area of 450 hectares following the River Idle northwards. The size of 600 football pitches, it is one of the largest sites for nature conservation in the East Midlands.

Yorkshire Wildlife Park is South Yorkshire’s newest attraction. Situated just outside Doncaster, the park occupies 70 acres of a 260 acre site, offering a unique view into the world of animals including lions, tigers, leopards, girraffes and baboons.

modules.title: Kids / Adventure
modules.html:
Hatfield Outdoor Activity Centre is a fantastic facility for outdoor enthusiastics and novices alike. Set against an idyllic woodland backdrop, the activity centre offers a range of water-based and land-based activities for all ages and abilities.

Bawtry Paintball and Laser Fields Europe’s Largest Paintball and outdoor Laser Combat Centre.Voted Britain’s Best Paintball Venue – 5 years running. Bawtry Paintball is a family run outdoor experience spanning across 352 acres of woodland.

The Doncaster Superbowl is the hottest Tenpin bowling centre around with fantastic facilities in a family friendly environment. The Superbowl features 24 brand new air conditioned lanes with the latest scoring system, mouth-watering food menu as well as a fully licensed modern bar. Not to forget an exciting amusements arcade area. Book online

modules.title: Day Trips
modules.html:
The historic towns of Lincoln and York are 40minutes and 60 minutes away respectfully

Yorkshire Sculpture Park in Wakefield is fantastic for families. You can explore and play together in 500 acres of beautiful landscape with contemporary sculpture throughout.

Cleethropes beach with famous Papa’s fish and chips is just over an hour away.
